image_description: A top-down view of a white bowl containing three scoops of ice cream. The central scoop is primarily white/cream with distinct pink swirls and small red flecks, suggesting a berry or fruit flavor. Two other scoops flank it, appearing more beige or light brown, possibly caramel or coffee flavored. There are visible signs of melting, with liquid pooling at the bottom of the bowl. A spoon rests in the bowl on the right side. The background includes a wooden surface and a patterned napkin or cloth on the left.
